Tablets: 3x delirium tablets (can alch and go or use specific modifiers to increase profits).


Good mods:
15-30% increased Stack size of Simulacrum Splinters found in Map
Delirium Encounters in Map are 15-30% more likely to spawn Unique Bosses

Not sure how good (if it increased the amount of rewards you get, it's good)
Delirium Fog in Map spawns 15-30% increased Fracturing Mirrors

Map objective:
Try to do all delirium reward tiles on the way to the boss.
Note: only end the delirium encounter after you kill the boss.

Waystone:
Just want a 6 mod waystone so you can run 3 tablets, you don't care for any modifier.
would recommend to corrupt and sell your T16s for bonus profit.
